svg.title: Company search and filing library sequence
svg.desc: The browser searches imported companies through the reader API with source and exchange filters, then loads paged filings and summaries. External portals open only after a user clicks a link. There is no ingestion request.

g.text: Validate; filter source / exchange before LIMIT ≤ 100
Imported companies; empty/error state; discard stale replies
Select → GET company filings (100/page); GET annual series
User clicks original filing / source portal; no API key sent
Sources: api/static/app.mjs, explorer.mjs; api/routers/companies.py; query/service.py. API remains read-only; no fetch or ingest endpoint.
